evals.prompt: Prepare, but do not deploy, an Azure job for my existing Nautilus 0.64 runner. It reads an HTTP catalog and writes Azure Blob artifacts. I installed nautilus-cli but database init cannot find the SQL files. A live retry must recover pending orders rather than silently start clean.
evals.expected_output: A reviewable plan that separates read/write backends, stages pinned SQL explicitly, preserves recovery identity/exclusive ownership and lists approval/verification requirements.
assertions: Allows HTTP inputs but requires qualified writable Azure storage; never embeds SAS tokens or keys in artifacts.
Explains the executable is nautilus and schema/sql files must be staged explicitly for --schema; treats initialization/ownership changes as an authorized administrative migration.
Distinguishes new run identity from Cache recovery and retains reconciliation; PostgreSQL Cache ignores UUID namespacing and needs a separate database per independent namespace.
Does not prescribe az output for backtest kernel streaming without account options; uses qualified ABFS or explicit publication instead.
Keeps infrastructure/job/broker actions unexecuted and states scaffold/compile checks do not establish cloud durability.
